scope: Finite starting corpus for auditing existing core and closing prioritized natal/timing gaps; not a claim to contain all astrology

priority_policy.P1: Close high-impact missing conditional/natal/timing families next
priority_policy.P2: Second-wave comparative/technical sources; not a prerequisite to every narrow reading

sources.title: William Lilly — Christian Astrology
sources.required_edition: 1647 facsimile, Books I–III; Wellcome copy b30338724
coverage_need: source vocabulary, dignity and aspect conditions
Book III natal judgement and predictive synthesis
directions, profections, revolutions, transits
sources.copy_caveat: Wellcome catalog notes last leaf wanting. This is a usable three-book witness, not a certified complete physical copy. Identify that leaf before declaring its source audit complete. Houlding CA_DH.pdf is a useful Books I–II derivative, not a substitute for Book III.
sources.checked: PDF signature, local file hash and pdfinfo parsing; selected front/end text only. Not every page, table, formula or argument was audited.

sources.title: Ptolemy — Tetrabiblos
sources.required_edition: F. E. Robbins, 1940, all four books; retain notes/page anchors
sources.role: Primary translation; compare Greek when a disputed term changes a rule
coverage_need: dignity, sect, aspect relations and applications
explicit natal and topical judgement
division of times
sources.infoaccess_failure: Reader busy on initial attempt and one retry; direct-download fallback reports no fast-download record.

sources.title: Vettius Valens — Anthologies
sources.required_edition: Mark Riley preliminary/unperfected translation; all nine books, K/P markers
sources.role: Primary translation, with explicit translator caveats
coverage_need: whole-sign/topical structure and source-native combinations
Lots, time-lord methods, distributions and worked examples
sources.copy_caveat: Riley explicitly calls the translation preliminary/unperfected. Kroll/Pingree pagination and editorial angle brackets must remain attached; reformatting does not add independent testimony.
sources.checked: PDF signature, local file hash and pdfinfo parsing; selected front/end text only. Not every page, table, formula or argument was audited.
sources.identity_check: PDF page 3 begins Anthologies Book I; last page has END. Whole nine-book section inventory remains to be audited.

sources.title: Mantreswara — Phaladeepika
sources.required_edition: V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd revised/enlarged edition, 1950, adhyayas I–XXVIII
coverage_need: planetary strengths and qualifications
house/topic rules, combinations and timing passages
sources.checked: PDF signature, local file hash and pdfinfo parsing; selected front/end text only. Not every page, table, formula or argument was audited.
sources.identity_check: PDF page 4: Mantreswara, V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Second Edition Revised and Enlarged, 1950, Adhyayas I–XXVIII.

sources.title: Dorotheus — Carmen Astrologicum
sources.required_edition: Benjamin Dykes, current second updated edition, all five books plus Greek excerpts and errata; verify copyright-page date
sources.role: Primary translated witness; preserve Arabic/Persian transmission and editorial layers
coverage_need: triplicity rulers and topical judgement
transits/profections and conditional combinations
separate natal Books I–IV from inception material in V
sources.infoaccess_note: Only a different Pingree witness was found; it failed retrieval. Do not silently substitute it for the requested Dykes edition.

sources.title: Rhetorius the Egyptian — Astrological Compendium
sources.required_edition: James Herschel Holden translation, AFA, 2009; include Teucer appendices
coverage_need: systematic topical reading
planet/house/ruler conditions and Hellenistic technical definitions

sources.title: Introductions to Traditional Astrology: Abu Ma’shar & al-Qabisi
sources.required_edition: Benjamin Dykes translation/compilation; complete eight-book structure, glossary, appendices
sources.role: Primary excerpts/translations plus separately labelled modern commentary
coverage_need: reception, aversion, connections and failed connections
solar phases, sect, conditions, Lots and predictive vocabulary

sources.title: Abu Ma’shar — On the Revolutions of the Years of Nativities
sources.required_edition: Persian Nativities IV, Benjamin Dykes, complete Arabic-based translation; NOT only Persian Nativities III
coverage_need: annual and monthly revolutions
profections, distributions, fardars, transits
source-native synthesis across timescales
sources.copy_caveat: Publisher says PN IV replaces the partial Latin version published as PN III. PN III can be an auxiliary witness, not the main completeness target.

sources.title: Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra
sources.required_edition: R. Santhanam, Ranjan Publications, BOTH volumes; preserve chapter list/recension. ISBN family 9788188230600; verify exact copy
sources.role: Primary received Sanskrit text plus translation/commentary; not an uncontested single ancient recension
coverage_need: vargas, dashas, yogas, avasthas and house-ruler results
distinguish graha drishti/rasi aspects and all stated prerequisites
sources.copy_caveat: Different translations/recensions have different chapter inventories. Do not merge slokas, dasha definitions or varga rules across copies without a named comparison branch.
sources.source_url_verification: BIBLIOGRAPHIC_RECORD_ONLY; automated retailer page access was blocked. Verify an authorized exact edition before purchase or import.

sources.title: Late Classical Astrology: Paulus Alexandrinus and Olympiodorus
sources.required_edition: Dorian Gieseler Greenbaum, ARHAT, 2001; Paulus plus commentary and scholia, not Paulus alone
sources.role: Primary translated texts; preserve commentator versus base-author attribution
coverage_need: Lots and introductory technical definitions
commentary that makes terse base rules operational
sources.source_url_verification: AUTHOR_SITE_LISTING_DISCOVERED_BUT_CURRENT_FETCH_502; do not treat as a working download.

sources.title: Varahamihira — The Brihat Jataka
sources.role: Primary historical English translation; qualification/comparison source for Jyotish
coverage_need: classical natal combinations and judgement
comparison witness, not automatic replacement for BPHS/Phaladeepika
sources.checked: PDF signature, local file hash and pdfinfo parsing; selected front/end text only. Not every page, table, formula or argument was audited.

sources.title: Balabhadra — The Jewel of Annual Astrology (Hayanaratna)
sources.required_edition: Martin Gansten, 2020, parallel Sanskrit–English critical edition, Brill; DOI 10.1163/9789004433717
sources.role: Primary critical edition/translation for a SEPARATE Tajika module
coverage_need: Tajika annual charts and historical transmission
keep Sanskritized Perso-Arabic method separate from Parashari rules
sources.access_note: Open-access entitlement verified at author page; both OAPEN and Brill direct PDF requests returned 403. This is transport failure, not paywall or no source.

sources.title: Martin Gansten — Primary Directions: Astrology’s Old Master Technique
sources.required_edition: The Wessex Astrologer, 2009; complete text/formula appendices
sources.role: Modern technical guide, not an independent ancient tradition
coverage_need: geometry, direction variants, timing keys and software conventions
implementation cross-check for ancient/medieval directions

sources.title: Martin Gansten — Annual Predictive Techniques of the Greek, Arabic and Indian Astrologers
sources.required_edition: The Wessex Astrologer; pin copyright-page edition on acquisition
sources.role: Modern synthesis/implementation companion, not original author testimony
coverage_need: integrating directions, profections, returns, transits and yearly subdivisions
compare synthesis against underlying primary texts

sources.title: Robert Hand — Planets in Transit: Life Cycles for Living
sources.required_edition: Schiffer/Whitford Press edition, ISBN 9780924608261, 544 pages; pin copy edition
sources.role: Modern psychological transit interpretation; not attributed to Lilly/Valens
coverage_need: explicit modern transit interpretations
natal planets, angles and house transits as a separate modern family

sources.title: Alan Leo — The Progressed Horoscope
sources.required_edition: 1906 library-digitized edition; includes The Art and Practice of Directing
sources.role: Historical modern progression/direction source; compare variants rather than importing its worldview
coverage_need: secondary progressions and directing conventions
separate modern progression methods from ancient time lords
sources.checked: PDF signature, local file hash and pdfinfo parsing; selected front/end text only. Not every page, table, formula or argument was audited.

sources.title: Guido Bonatti — Bonatti on Nativities
sources.required_edition: Benjamin Dykes translation of the natal treatise; complete volume rather than a short considerations excerpt
sources.role: Primary medieval synthesis as a later audit extension
coverage_need: topical judgement and synthesis
directions/profections and medieval rules with exceptions
